title: Intent is set on three paired pads chosen from what varies independently in the data
context: 01-defs.js and 31-pads.js define three X/Y pads (stiffness × pore size, main axis × off-axis share, porosity × pore spread), each off / prefer / require, instead of a slider per metric. Ranges are fixed from the 2026-10-09 data; derived metrics (stiff_main, stiff_ratio, porosity) are computed in 12-search-core.js addDerived.

options.name: Three pads on independent axes (current)
options.summary: Pairs follow the correlation structure: density, direction, pore uniformity.
pros: Users cannot ask for impossible combinations as easily
cons: Pad ranges and pairings depend on today's data and need re-checking after the Vault reseed

options.name: One slider per metric
cons: Most combinations unreachable (old Volume × Thermal pad was two-thirds unreachable)

options.name: Pads derived from the data at load
options.summary: Compute principal directions or correlations from the bundle's seeds and lay out pads automatically.
cons: Axes stop being nameable physical quantities

recommendation: Matt's v0.5.0 decisions in the recap; README "The three pads" gives the correlation evidence; implemented in 01-defs.js, 31-pads.js and 12-search-core.js.

log_refs.entry: v0.5.0: Pads re-paired around what varies on its own
